title: 第0020章 土中生绿芽人心起疯痧第0019章 井底的叹息草木的命门
lines: 日头毒得像是淬了火的钢针，密密麻麻地扎在耙耧山脉的脊梁上。药王沟的土被烤得发白，裂开一道道口子，像是一张张干渴到极致的嘴，无声地向着老天爷讨水喝。
雪见坐在自家院子里的磨盘上，手里紧紧攥着那株刚从绝命崖底挖回来的雪见草。草茎莹白，叶片上还带着一丝不属于这旱天的阴凉。自从吃了这草，她的耳朵里就再也清净不下来。风过树梢，不再是单纯的沙沙声，而是无数细碎的、凄厉的呜咽；连脚下踩着的黄土，都在发出沉闷的喘息。
屋里传来一声微弱得像猫叫的呼唤。雪见猛地回过神，把雪见草塞进贴身的衣兜里，快步走进屋。炕上，五岁的半夏蜷缩成一团，小脸蜡黄，呼吸急促得像破风箱。他的喉咙里像是堵着一团浸了水的棉花，每喘一口气都要耗尽全身的力气。
“半夏，娘在。”雪见握住儿子滚烫的小手，眼眶干涩得发疼。村里人都说，半夏这病是命里带的，是“半夏生毒”，无药可医。可她不信。她既然能从绝命崖下把雪见草带回来，就一定能从阎王爷手里把儿子的命抢回来。
“娘，我听见草在哭。”半夏忽然睁开眼，浑浊的眼珠子里映出雪见憔悴的脸，“它们说，土要渴死了，人也要渴死了。”
雪见心头一震。这孩子，难道也遗传了那草木的灵性？她还没来得及细想，院门外突然传来一阵杂乱的脚步声，伴随着粗重的喘息和压抑的惊呼。
“支书！支书你在吗？出大事了！”
是村长独活。他的声音里带着一丝难以掩饰的亢奋，像是饿狼闻到了血腥味。
雪见站起身，走出屋子。院子里已经挤满了人，黑压压的一片，却静得可怕。所有人的眼睛都死死盯着院子中央那块被太阳晒得发烫的空地。
独活站在人群最前面，手里拄着一根旱烟袋，烟锅里的火星子一明一灭。他看见雪见出来，脸上立刻堆起一种诡异的笑容，那笑容在他那张沟壑纵横的脸上挤成一团，像是一朵开败了的菊花。
“雪见，你快来看！”独活用烟袋锅子指着空地中央，声音压得极低，却字字砸在每个人的心坎上，“这鬼天气，连井底都冒火星子了，可这地里……竟然长出了绿芽！”
雪见顺着他指的方向看去，瞳孔骤然收缩。
在那片干裂得像龟甲一样的黄土地上，一株嫩绿的幼苗正倔强地顶开土块，舒展开两片叶子。那叶子绿得刺眼，绿得妖异，在这满目焦黄、死气沉沉的院子里，像是一滴落在宣纸上的浓墨，又像是从地狱里伸出来的一只绿色鬼手。
人群开始骚动。
“是药！肯定是药！”
“老天爷显灵了！这是救命的药啊！”
“放屁！大旱天里长绿芽，这是妖邪！是山神爷发怒了！”
各种声音像炸了锅的蚂蚁，嗡嗡嗡地在雪见耳边乱撞。她听懂了那些声音背后的东西——不是敬畏，不是感恩，而是赤裸裸的、几乎要将人吞噬的贪婪。
独活凑到雪见身边，压低了声音，热气喷在她的耳廓上：“雪见，你是吃了雪见草的人，你听听，这芽在说啥？是不是在说，咱们药王沟的穷日子，到头了？”
雪见没有说话。她的耳朵里，确实听到了声音。
那不是喜悦的歌唱，也不是神明的恩赐。那株绿芽发出的，是一种尖锐的、充满怨毒的嘶鸣。它在喊疼，在喊渴，在喊着一个字——
雪见猛地抬起头，看向独活。独活的眼神里闪烁着一种她从未见过的光芒，那光芒比头顶的烈日还要灼人。她知道，独活这个名字，在《草木生死簿》上对应的，是“一生孤苦，执拗如铁”。可此刻，这块铁，已经被欲望烧红了，烫得能烙穿人的皮肉。
“村长，”雪见的声音沙哑得像两块石头在摩擦，“这芽，不能动。它不是药，是祸。”
“祸？”独活冷笑一声，烟袋锅子在鞋底上磕了磕，震落一截灰白的烟灰，“雪见，你吃了仙草，成了半仙，可别忘了，你还是药王沟的支书！全村百十口人的命，都指望着这口井、这片地！现在老天爷把绿芽送到了咱们家门口，你却说是祸？你这是要断大家的活路！”
“我的活路，是我儿子的命！”雪见毫不退让地迎上他的目光，“这芽长在绝命崖的阴影里，吸的是地底的阴气，它救不了人，只会要人的命！”
“放屁！”独活猛地提高音量，脖子上的青筋暴起，“什么阴气阳气！能换钱、能换粮、能换命的，就是正气！雪见，你别以为吃了棵草就能压我一头。这药王沟，姓的是‘药’，不姓‘雪’！”
人群再次骚动起来。这一次，附和独活的声音占了多数。
“是啊，支书，你就让我们试试吧！”
“我家里还有八十岁的老娘等着喝水呢！”
“就算是毒草，也比干等着强啊！”
雪见看着眼前这些熟悉的面孔。白芷、紫苏、辛夷……这些在《草木生死簿》上本该有着纯净名字的人，此刻，他们的眼睛里都蒙上了一层浑浊的灰翳。她听懂了，那不是他们的声音，那是人心深处，名为“疯痧”的毒虫在噬咬。
大旱烤干了土地，也烤干了人心里的最后一丝敬畏。当生存的底线被击穿，当欲望的闸门被撬开，再淳朴的人，也会变成比草木更可怕的怪物。
“好。”雪见忽然开口，声音平静得连她自己都感到陌生。
content_en:
The sun is as poisonous as a tempered steel needle, densely piercing the backbone of the Rake Mountains. The soil in Yaowanggou was baked white and cracked, like mouths that were extremely thirsty, silently asking God for water.
Xuejian was sitting on the millstone in his yard, holding tightly the Xuejian grass that had just been dug up from the bottom of Jueming Cliff. The grass stems are shiny white, and there is a hint of coolness on the leaves that does not belong to this dry day. Ever since she ate this grass, her ears could no longer be purified. The wind blowing through the treetops is no longer a simple rustling sound, but countless tiny, shrill sobs; even the loess underfoot is letting out a dull gasp.
"Mother..."
A faint call like a cat's meow came from inside the house. Xuejian suddenly came back to his senses, stuffed the Xuejian grass into his close-fitting pocket, and walked quickly into the house. On the kang, five-year-old Banxia huddled up in a ball, her little face was sallow, and her breathing was as rapid as a broken bellows. His throat felt like a ball of water-soaked cotton, and every breath he took took all his strength.
"Ban Xia, mother is here." Xue Jian held her son's hot little hand, her eyes so dry that it hurt. People in the village say that the disease of Pinellia ternata is born in fate, and is a "poison caused by Pinellia ternata", and there is no cure. But she didn't believe it. Since she can bring Xuejiancao back from the cliff of death, she can definitely snatch her son's life back from the hands of the Lord of Hell.
"Mom, I heard the grass crying." Banxia suddenly opened her eyes, and Xuejian's haggard face was reflected in her cloudy eyes. "They said that the soil will die of thirst, and people will die of thirst too."
Xue Jian's heart was shocked. Did this child also inherit the spirituality of the plants and trees? Before she had time to think about it, there was suddenly a burst of chaotic footsteps outside the courtyard door, accompanied by heavy breathing and suppressed exclamations.
"Party Secretary! Party Secretary, are you there? Something big has happened!"
It is the village chief who lives alone. There was a hint of excitement in his voice that was hard to conceal, like a hungry wolf smelling blood.
Xuejian stood up and walked out of the house. The courtyard was already crowded with people, and it was dark but eerily quiet. Everyone's eyes were fixed on the open space in the center of the yard that was heated by the sun.
Duhuo stood at the front of the crowd, holding a dry pipe in his hand, and the sparks in the pot flickered. When he saw Xue Jian coming out, a strange smile immediately appeared on his face. The smile was squeezed into a ball on his face with crisscrossed grooves, like a chrysanthemum that had failed to bloom.
"Xuejian, come and see!" Duhuo pointed to the center of the open space with his pipe and pot, his voice was very low, but every word struck everyone's heart, "In this damn weather, even sparks are rising from the bottom of the well, but here... there are green buds growing!"
Xuejian looked in the direction he pointed, and her pupils suddenly shrank.
On that piece of yellow earth that was as dry and cracked as a tortoise shell, a green seedling was stubbornly pushing through the soil and spreading out its two leaves. The leaves were dazzlingly green and eerie green. In this scorched, lifeless yard, they looked like a drop of thick ink falling on rice paper, or like a green ghost hand stretching out from hell.
The crowd began to stir.
"It's medicine! It must be medicine!"
"God has appeared! This is life-saving medicine!"
"Fart! Green buds grow during the drought. This is evil! The mountain god is angry!"
All kinds of sounds were like ants exploding in a pot, buzzing around Xuejian's ears. She understood what was behind those voices—not awe, not gratitude, but naked, almost devouring greed.
Duhuo came closer to Xuejian, lowered his voice, and blew hot air on her ear: "Xuejian, you are the one who has eaten Xuejian grass. Listen, what are these buds saying? Are they saying that our poor days in Yaowanggou are over?"
Xuejian said nothing. She did hear sounds in her ears.
It was not a song of joy, nor was it a gift from the gods. The green bud emits a sharp, spiteful neigh. It is crying out for pain, crying out for thirst, and shouting one word——
"Poison!"
Xuejian suddenly raised his head and looked at Duhuo. There was a light in Du Huo's eyes that she had never seen before, and that light was more scorching than the scorching sun above her head. She knew that the name Duhuo corresponded to "a life of loneliness and stubbornness as iron" in the Book of Life and Death of Grass and Trees. But at this moment, this piece of iron has been burned red by desire, so hot that it can burn through people's flesh.
"Village chief," Xuejian's voice was as hoarse as two stones rubbing against each other, "this bud cannot be moved. It is not medicine, it is a disaster."
"Misfortune?" Duhuo sneered, and the pot of the pipe knocked against the sole of his shoe, knocking off a section of gray ash. "Xuejian, you ate the fairy grass and became a half-immortal, but don't forget that you are still the party secretary of Yaowanggou! The lives of hundreds of people in the village depend on this well and this land! Now God has sent green sprouts to our doorstep, but you call it a disaster? You are trying to cut off everyone's livelihood!"
"My only way to survive is my son's life!" Xuejian met his gaze without giving in. "This bud grows in the shadow of Jueming Cliff. It sucks the Yin Qi from the ground. It can't save people, it can only kill them!"
"Fart!" Duhuo suddenly raised his voice, and the veins on his neck popped out, "What Yin Qi and Yang Qi! What can be exchanged for money, food, and lives is righteousness! Xue Jian, don't think that eating a piece of grass can defeat me. This Yaowanggou's surname is 'Yao', not 'Xue'!"
The crowd was in commotion again. This time, voices in favor of independent living accounted for the majority.
"Yes, Party Secretary, just let us try it!"
"I still have an 80-year-old woman waiting for a drink of water at home!"
"Even if it's a poisonous weed, it's better than just waiting!"
Xuejian looked at the familiar faces in front of him. Angelica dahurica, Zisu, Xinyi... these people who should have pure names in the "Book of Life and Death", at this moment, their eyes are covered with a layer of turbid gray. She understands, isn’t that right?
title_en: Chapter 0020: Green sprouts grow in the soil, people go crazy Chapter 0019: The sigh at the bottom of the well, the life gate of vegetation
